topic.label: Data Science
topic.desc: Data Science: extracting reliable knowledge from data through statistics, machine learning, data engineering and clear communication.

concepts: Estimating population quantities and testing hypotheses from samples, with explicit uncertainty through confidence intervals, p-values and posterior distributions.
Building predictive models that learn patterns from data, from supervised classification and regression to unsupervised clustering and deep learning.
Acquiring, cleaning, joining and storing data so it is consistent, documented and queryable at scale.
Turning analyses into honest charts, dashboards and narratives that decision makers can read correctly.
Designing controlled experiments and using observational methods to estimate causal effects rather than mere correlation.
Privacy, fairness, consent and reproducibility obligations that govern how data is collected, modeled and shared.
skills: Selects and runs the appropriate significance test for a stated question and checks its assumptions and effect size before reporting.
Fits linear and generalized linear regression models and checks residual diagnostics, multicollinearity and coefficient intervals.
Specifies priors and likelihoods, samples posterior distributions and checks convergence diagnostics and posterior predictive fit.
Trains and tunes classification models with cross-validation and checks held-out accuracy, calibration and class balance.
Groups unlabeled records with clustering algorithms and checks cluster stability and silhouette scores across seeds.
Derives, encodes and selects predictive features and checks for target leakage and train-test drift.
Detects and repairs missing values, duplicates, outliers and type errors and checks row counts and null rates before and after.
Writes analytical SQL against warehouse tables and checks results against independent aggregate counts.
Designs extract-transform-load pipelines with schema contracts and checks each run with data quality assertions.
Chooses chart forms and visual encodings for a dataset and checks that axes, scales and colors do not distort the data.
Profiles distributions, correlations and anomalies in a new dataset and checks findings against summary statistics.
Assembles metric dashboards from warehouse queries and checks every tile against its source query.
Plans randomized experiments with power calculations and guardrail metrics and checks sample ratio and pre-period balance.
Estimates treatment effects with matching, difference-in-differences or instrumental variables and checks robustness to confounding.
Builds seasonal time series forecasts and checks backtest error against naive baselines.
Measures disparate performance of a model across groups and checks results against stated fairness criteria.
Identifies personal data and re-identification risk in a dataset and checks proposed anonymization against it.
Reruns an analysis from versioned code and data and checks that reported numbers are reproduced exactly.
